Learning outcomes: planning optimization, encode chromosome/fitness by hand, compare classical/hybrid methods.

Population iteration for complex layouts/local dead ends; shortest distance alone ignores safety, smoothness and effort; exhaustive waypoint enumeration impractical.

exclusions.1298: Learning objectives, all substantive outcomes reviewed on following pages

remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Separate normalization, crossover and mutation questions do not test one integrated generation with final evaluation and fixed-size elitism. Q027 repeats a simple swap rather than adding a distinct reasoning angle.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Replace Q027 or add a bounded hard trace with declared draw/pair/mutation/elite rules. Require decoded child costs, current evaluated best and exact next-population membership; do not invent a source-run result.

remainingBoundedGaps.finding: No combined binary-chromosome decoding, energy ranking and selection-weight transformation exercise; all current items isolate one step.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add a source-derived synthesis question with explicit bit operations or positive-weight transformation and declared selection policy. Include full wrong-option arithmetic and distinguish continuous from discrete optima.

remainingBoundedGaps.finding: The contour axes extend to 2 radians while the declared feasible domain ends at pi/2. Author notes preserve this but no concept/question tests that distinction.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add a diagram/domain interpretation item: a displayed point need not be admissible; do not silently expand the optimization bounds.

remainingBoundedGaps.finding: The collision-checking tip, occupancy lookup followed by geometric collision tests, is not mapped to a discriminating question; existing p1335 items cover only normalization and plotting.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add a bounded implementation scenario contrasting coarse occupancy lookup with exact geometry/whole-route checks under explicit point-versus-finite-body assumptions.

sourceQualifications: Keep original printed arithmetic, derivative, finite-penalty and score-domain conflicts visible. The p1324 arrow misread is corrected separately and must not be counted as a source issue.
questionVsConcept: Seventy draft records are not automatically seventy unique concepts. Q012/Q016 are cost-evaluation variants and Q026/Q027 repeat the same crossover operator; ledger should retain page coverage while avoiding inflated unique conceptual coverage.
tableRemainder: All eight source pendulum rows were inspected. The omitted direct variants (12,48) and (84,78) evaluate to 4.0113728823 and 1.9336721456; they do not require separate questions merely to inflate totals.
presentation: Stored correct option IDs follow a cyclic pattern. Existing answer-independent display/export permutation fix is already recorded centrally; no question mutation is requested merely to change stable IDs.
